verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents an OpenTelemetry integration page and its GitHub README claims 'real-time monitoring, alerting, and logging' as part of the platform, plus a TUI for real-time observability into tasks/workflows/workers. However, there is no concrete detail on which metrics (failure rates, latencies, queue depths) are exported, no evidence of alert rule configuration, and no independent confirmation that alerting actually fires as described. Missing for 10: detailed OpenTelemetry metrics/export documentation, explicit failure-rate/latency/queue-depth metric definitions, documented alerting configuration/integration with observability stacks (Grafana/Datadog/PagerDuty), and hands-on or community confirmation that alerts work in practice.
